name: F_flicker_360p
notes: 24.000s of continuously varying colour + two moving elements, with 12 SINGLE-FRAME pure-white flashes at the frame indices listed in flash_frames[]. Each flash lasts 1/30s = 33.3ms. A tile grid that spends a cell on a flash wastes that cell's whole time span, and a scene detector that thresholds naively will report 24 cuts where there are none. Content is designed so the luma of neighbouring normal frames differs by < 2/255, making a white frame pop.
